comments.value: Honestly I've always said this. make it a toggleable option, tho I personally have never done so as it's against the terms of service, I know a lot of people who use hacked clients solely to add in this ability and pretty much all of them have said the same thing that the performance impact is minimal and considering it's simple enough for them to implement I find it frankly hilarious that the devs haven't implemented it themself already
custom client enables this.. but its super slow.
@{5a015331a6fd0876a51d5148|full_name}: Modded clients are against the rules and can get you banned. What we want is the interactive dynamic bones to be officially implemented into the vanilla client.
Bring this back :( I remember this from the good old days

I remember once my hand grazed nearby a character's ears and they moved to the side. I know it was just coincidental timing of their head movement with my hand but for that brief moment I felt an actual level of immersion like the character before me was more than just an image within my headset. If it was an actually implemented feature, now that would just take the cake.

I mostly want to have something more interactive when my friends go to pat my avatar. It would be nice to see how they react to the jiggle bones and such on my avatars as i usually use a lot of small, fluffy cute things. despite me being bound to PC, it would be nice to have that slight level of extra immersion.
It's pretty sad they still haven't even talked about adding support for this, it's such a simple addon.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: i think this one is done now
This was released with Avatar Dynamics.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Many claps for Tupper and the rest of the dev team! Huge round of applause for making such an incredible free feature! :D
Yay! This turned out awesome btw

details: Please allow us to interact with each others dynamic bones with hands and other parts of our avatar, such as being able to touch other avatars's hair and having it move depending on how we touch it. This should also have the ability to be disabled for people who are uncomfortable with being touched, or so people can save frames. This could add a whole new level or interaction and immersion into the game
title: Interactive Avatars

voters.name: Nathaniel Eliab De Los Santos Jimenez
